chat.message: Is it OK if I bring my coffee? It's in a sealed travel cup.
Yeah no problem, as long as it's sealed.
It's one of those Yeti tumblers, never spills. Thanks!
Thanks for the ride. Have a good one!
Thank you! Five stars to you.
Hi Charlotte, I found a coffee spill on the back seat when I was cleaning tonight. The photo shows it clearly. I believe it happened during our ride. I've filed a cleaning claim for $35.
That wasn't me. My coffee was in a sealed Yeti tumbler — I told you that. I never opened it in the car. You did 4 rides after mine. The spill was from one of those riders. I'm disputing this.

dispute.driver_statement: The rider admitted carrying coffee in the chat. She said it was a 'sealed Yeti tumbler' but the spill pattern matches an open cup, not a sealed one. The photo is genuine — 0.91 authenticity score. I found it when I cleaned the car that night. I filed within 18 hours, well under the 24-hour threshold. I did do more rides after hers, but I check the car between rides and didn't notice it until the deep clean at night. The spill was under the seat, not visible from the front. The $35 covers professional detailing.
dispute.rider_statement: The driver is blaming me for a coffee spill I didn't cause. I brought a sealed Yeti tumbler — the driver even acknowledged it was sealed. I never opened it during the ride. The driver did 4 more rides after mine before finding the spill 18 hours later. The photo might be real but the damage wasn't from me. The driver has filed 5 cleaning claims in 90 days — that's a pattern. This is a shakedown.

policies.rule_text: A cleaning fee is payable to the driver where a verified photograph shows damage or soiling caused during the trip, capped at $25.
policies.title: Cleaning Fee - Verified Damage

policies.rule_text: Where the submitted photograph fails authenticity verification, the claim is dismissed.
policies.title: Unverified or Fabricated Evidence

policies.rule_text: Damage reported more than 24 hours after trip end is presumed pre-existing unless the driver produces contemporaneous evidence.
policies.title: Prior Damage
